mentions.name: Wax
mentions.description: An embeddable programming language with time-travel debugging and observability, built around deterministic replay that works across operating systems and CPU architectures. Runs at roughly 70% the speed of C: record a run on one platform and play it back identically on any other, and fits inside existing apps as an embeddable language.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://waxlang.dev

timetravel debugging and observability on steroids. Deterministic replay that works across operation systems and cpu architectures. 70% as fast C, record one one platform, play it back identically anywhere else. Fits inside apps you already have as an embeddable language.
